profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer | Enterprise Platform | AI-Native Workflows (Agentic, MCP, RAG) | IAM | 15+ Yrs Building Life Sciences SaaS | MS in Computing Science
profile.jobTitle: Senior Principal Software Engineer | Cloud & Agentic AI
profile.summary:
Hands-On Senior Principal Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience architecting enterprise-scale platforms, developer ecosystems, and AI-native systems. Throughout my career, I have led complex technical initiatives from zero-to-one design to multi-tenant global production.

I have designed and built mission-critical platforms at extreme scale—spanning enterprise B2B SaaS in life sciences to distributed computing environments processing petabyte-scale planetary data:

• Elsevier (Enterprise SaaS & Life Sciences): As the core developer behind the Elsevier Text Mining SaaS platform, I built and scaled secure multi-tenant capabilities, robust REST APIs & webhooks, and enterprise IAM architectures serving leading global pharmaceutical organizations.

• NOAA NESDIS (Enterprise Data & HPC): Engineered enterprise-scale satellite data acquisition and dissemination architectures, designing high-throughput data pipelines and leveraging High-Performance Computing (HPC) clusters for continuous, large-scale satellite data reprocessing and low-latency distribution.

• The Agentic Advantage (AI-Native Engineering): Champion of autonomous AI workflows and agentic development—integrating LLM, tools (RAG, web search, quality gates), agents and MCP protocol to eliminate repetitive coding toil, accelerate delivery cycles, and maximize high-leverage architectural thinking.

This foundation across modern cloud SaaS, high-throughput distributed data systems (HPC, distributed pipelines), and cutting-edge agentic workflows allows me to bring structure to ambiguous architectural challenges and deliver resilient, high-performance enterprise infrastructure.

Portfolio & Architecture Demos:
Explore my technical case studies, system design write-ups, and live AI/MCP implementations:

Website: https://sam-lee-home.github.io/Sam-Lee-Home/ 
Github:  https://github.com/Sam-Lee-Home/Sam-Lee-Home

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer | Cloud & Agentic AI
positions.description:
NOAA - NESDIS Innovation Hub (NIH)

Led the architectural transformation of NIH into an enterprise Center of Excellence for Agentic AI and cloud-native systems, translating scientific research into production platforms engineered for high performance, cost efficiency, and security.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Agentic AI & Dev Leverage: Architected an AI development harness (Cline) using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and RAG (AWS Bedrock); integrated SonarQube quality gates and Graphify knowledge graphs to mitigate hallucinations.

• Full-Stack Orchestration GUI: Architected and built the management interface for the Algorithm Orchestration (AO) engine using React, TypeScript, and FastAPI, enabling operators to configure workflows, execute pipelines, and inspect live outputs in real time.

• IaC & Zero-Trust Security: Standardized multi-account provisioning via Terraform and CloudFormation; engineered a zero-trust identity layer using IAM Roles Anywhere, IAM Identity Center (SSO), and Amazon Cognito.

• High-Throughput APIs & Serverless: Built serverless event pipelines and REST APIs via Python, FastAPI, API Gateway direct service proxies, and S3/Lambda to bypass compute overhead and maximize throughput at scale.

• PB-Scale Data & HPC: Architected PB-scale storage lifecycles and batch workflows using S3 Inventory, Athena, and S3 Batch Operations alongside HPC clusters for continuous satellite reprocessing.

• Strategic AI Prototyping: Spearheaded GenAI roadmaps and built agentic prototypes across Bedrock, SageMaker, and open models (Gemma) for autonomous data extraction.

• Mentorship & Governance: Delivered an enterprise cloud/AI curriculum, upskilling ~100 engineers and contractors on modern cloud architectures and agentic workflows.

• Recognition: Honored with the 2025 NESDIS Award for technical leadership, architectural innovation, and mission impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led architecture, delivery, and platform engineering for Elsevier’s flagship Life Sciences SaaS platforms—Entellect and Elsevier Text Mining—delivering multi-tenant semantic search, data pipelines, and NLP to global pharmaceutical enterprises.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Full-Lifecycle Enterprise SaaS Ownership: Owned the zero-to-one design, multi-tenant cloud architecture, CI/CD, and L3 production support for the Elsevier Text Mining SaaS platform.

• IAM & Multi-Tenancy: Architected secure tenant isolation, automated onboarding, and enterprise RBAC via OAuth 2.0/OIDC (AWS Cognito) to meet Fortune 500 pharma compliance standards.

• Enterprise APIs & Integrations: Built high-performance REST APIs and webhook pipelines enabling external pharma systems to query, annotate, and index large-scale scientific literature assets.

• Biomedical Ingestion & Taxonomies: Engineered automated ingestion pipelines processing millions of literature assets (PubMed/MEDLINE, full-text journals, clinical trials), standardizing unstructured evidence via MeSH, UMLS, and SNOMED-CT.

• Biomedical NLP & Evidence Extraction: Architected scalable NLP pipelines (NER and Relation Extraction) to extract drug-gene-disease relationships, mechanisms of action, and therapeutic signals for drug repurposing.

• IaC & Reliability: Automated multi-environment provisioning using Terraform (IaC), guaranteeing tenant isolation, high availability, and operational resilience across global deployments.

• Scientific & Bioinformatician Partnership: Collaborated with bioinformaticians, computational biologists, and clinical researchers to build low-latency semantic search, automated citation links, and knowledge graphs.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 2275 Research Blvd, Suite 500, Rockville, MD 20850 · On-site
positions.description:
Delivered enterprise software architecture, clinical data interoperability, and mission-critical platform engineering for public health and federal agencies, including the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), and Department of Homeland Security (DHS), in partnership with SAIC, IBM, and Northrop Grumman.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Oncology Clinical Decision Support (ASCO): Architected and deployed the Rapid Learning System (RLS) prototype to aggregate cancer patient records, Electronic Health Records (EHR), and longitudinal clinical endpoints using OpenMRS, Mirth Connect, and PopHealth; integrated Drools rule engines and JAX-RS services to enable oncologists to synthesize clinical evidence for rapid guideline development and quality-of-care improvement.

• Healthcare Workforce & Clinician Platform (HHS): Engineered the BMISS enterprise web platform to administer clinician scholarship and loan-repayment pipelines for underserved communities, implementing modular service layers and relational persistence architectures using JBoss, JSF/PrimeFaces, and SQL Server/Hibernate.

• Federated Data Interoperability & Exchange (DHS): Architected high-security inter-agency information-sharing platforms (DPICS2) compliant with federal exchange standards (LEXS, NIEM); implemented service-oriented architectures (SOA) utilizing IBM WebSphere DataPower, JAX-WS, and Spring Security (LDAP) to broker sensitive intelligence feeds across federal law enforcement bodies (FBI, DOJ, DHS).

• Automated Risk Assessment & Rules Processing: Designed and deployed the Risk Classification Assessment (RSA) engine, establishing real-time interfaces with Automated Threat Priority (ATP) infrastructure via secure SOA web services and fine-grained data access layers.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Web Development · Linux · JavaScript · Software Development · PostgreSQL · SQL

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led search architecture and backend data engineering for Going Out Guide, The Washington Post’s high-traffic metropolitan entertainment and discovery platform, delivering real-time geospatial search, batch data ingestion, and interactive digital experiences to regional audiences.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Enterprise Search Architecture & Discovery: Architected and deployed enterprise search capabilities on FAST ESP (Enterprise Search Platform), engineering multi-attribute faceted filtering, custom relevancy ranking algorithms, geospatial search, and sub-second auto-complete/query suggestions across extensive entertainment catalogs.

• High-Throughput Batch Ingestion & ETL: Built a resilient batch ETL framework to ingest, transform, and normalize heterogeneous structured and unstructured feeds—including syndicated movie/trailer metadata and enterprise Oracle databases—for continuous, low-latency search re-indexing.

• Full-Stack Engineering & Geospatial Services: Developed modular web applications and MVC backend services leveraging Spring MVC, iBatis, GlassFish, and PostgreSQL/Oracle; integrated interactive Google Maps APIs and asynchronous front-end services (jQuery/AJAX) optimized for high concurrency, caching, and enterprise SEO standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Web Development · Linux · JavaScript · Software Development · PostgreSQL · SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and scaled mission-critical educational platforms serving millions of students nationwide, leading backend system design, batch ingestion optimization, and distributed transaction processing across flagship registration and reporting services.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• High-Volume Transaction & Registration Platform: Engineered core transactional workflows and web architectures for the nationwide SAT Online Registration platform (nsat.collegeboard.com), delivering secure, high-concurrency seat reservation, payment processing, and test scheduling capabilities for millions of students.

• Batch Processing Optimization & Performance Engineering: Re-engineered the distributed score ingestion and processing pipeline for My College QuickStart (PSAT/NMSQT), refining batch partitioning algorithms and database concurrency to slash runtime from 3 days to 8 hours (89% latency reduction) across millions of student records.

• Automated Paper-to-Digital Ingestion Pipelines: Built fault-tolerant batch ETL frameworks utilizing XMLBean, Flux, and Tumbleweed secure transfer protocols to automate the ingestion, validation, and digitization of millions of physical paper registrations into enterprise Oracle databases.

• Enterprise Java Platform Modernization: Designed multi-tier enterprise applications utilizing BEA WebLogic, EJB, Struts MVC, and iBatis persistence layers, maintaining rigorous data integrity and high availability during peak seasonal registration spikes.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Web Development · Linux · JavaScript · Software Development · PostgreSQL · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer V (Air Traffic Management)
positions.description:
Contributed to software system architecture, distributed decision-support platforms, and mission-critical integration initiatives for next-generation Air Traffic Management (ATM) programs, supporting national FAA airspace modernization efforts and research testbeds within the Boeing ATM Laboratory.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Federal Airspace Modernization & Architecture: Co-architected the technical transition strategy and distributed software architecture for Boeing’s proposal toward the FAA Traffic Flow Management Modernization contract, establishing scalable blueprints for national airspace automation and infrastructure evolution.

• Collaborative Decision-Making (CDM) Platforms: Engineered and deployed a web-based collaborative decision-support platform to model and mitigate real-time airport surface and terminal airspace congestion, establishing shared situational awareness and coordinated flow management across stakeholders.

• Mission-Critical Systems Integration: Architected distributed integration layers within the Boeing ATM Laboratory, federating real-time data feeds and control messaging across core aviation subsystems, including the CDMnet collaboration network, OpsControl flight planner, AIS flight scheduler, and AADS airspace situational displays.

positions.title: Consultant / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered enterprise systems integration, transaction processing, and software engineering for Amtrak’s passenger reservation and revenue management infrastructure, modernizing commercial rail operations and international compliance workflows.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Enterprise Revenue Management Integration: Evaluated, customized, and integrated the commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) RailRev2 revenue management platform, integrating yield-optimization algorithms and dynamic fare-allocation workflows into core enterprise booking engines.

• Cross-Border Regulatory & Clearance Automation: Engineered backend integration pipelines to automate the Canadian Border Crossing pre-arrival customs clearance system, establishing secure, transactional data exchange between manifest databases and immigration enforcement agencies.

• Point-of-Sale (POS) & High-Speed Rail Systems: Developed and deployed automated on-board fee collection and passenger ticketing modules for the flagship Acela Express service, ensuring high transaction integrity and offline/online data reconciliation for rail operations.

positions.title: Consultant / Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 9/F TBC(S90), Heathrow Airport, Middlesex, United Kingdom
positions.description:
Delivered mission-critical software engineering, algorithmic pricing engines, and enterprise integrations for the WorldCargo division, supporting 24/7 global freight logistics, high-volume revenue accounting, and international customs clearance systems.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Algorithmic Pricing & Revenue Architecture: Engineered core transaction modules for AutoRate, an automated global cargo rating and dynamic pricing engine, optimizing high-volume rate evaluations across multi-currency freight contracts and complex routing networks.

• Intelligent Freight Processing & Hub Automation: Developed real-time tracking, allocation, and handling systems for Ascentis, the automated freight management platform powering operations at London Heathrow Airport, improving hub throughput and container transit tracking.

• B2B Trading Platform & Systems Integration: Architected external integration interfaces to connect British Airways WorldCargo systems with GF-x (Global Freight Exchange), enabling real-time digital booking, capacity distribution, and inventory sharing across global airline trading networks.

• Regulatory Compliance & Cross-Border Logistics: Built secure, automated data-exchange interfaces with US Customs to enable pre-arrival electronic cargo clearance, mitigating port-of-entry dwell times and ensuring strict adherence to cross-border shipping regulations.

• Enterprise Financial Transformation & Accounting: Led software modifications for Crisalis (enterprise revenue accounting) and delivered the European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) Euro-currency transition, re-engineering ledger computation and transaction systems for seamless dual-currency conversion without transactional downtime.

experience.description:
NOAA - NESDIS Innovation Hub (NIH)

Led the architectural transformation of NIH into an enterprise Center of Excellence for Agentic AI and cloud-native systems, translating scientific research into production platforms engineered for high performance, cost efficiency, and security.

Key Achievements & Technical Leadership:

• Agentic AI & Dev Leverage: Architected an AI development harness (Cline) using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and RAG (AWS Bedrock); integrated SonarQube quality gates and Graphify knowledge graphs to mitigate hallucinations.

• Full-Stack Orchestration GUI: Architected and built the management interface for the Algorithm Orchestration (AO) engine using React, TypeScript, and FastAPI, enabling operators to configure workflows, execute pipelines, and inspect live outputs in real time.

• IaC & Zero-Trust Security: Standardized multi-account provisioning via Terraform and CloudFormation; engineered a zero-trust identity layer using IAM Roles Anywhere, IAM Identity Center (SSO), and Amazon Cognito.

• High-Throughput APIs & Serverless: Built serverless event pipelines and REST APIs via Python, FastAPI, API Gateway direct service proxies, and S3/Lambda to bypass compute overhead and maximize throughput at scale.

• PB-Scale Data & HPC: Architected PB-scale storage lifecycles and batch workflows using S3 Inventory, Athena, and S3 Batch Operations alongside HPC clusters for continuous satellite reprocessing.

• Strategic AI Prototyping: Spearheaded GenAI roadmaps and built agentic prototypes across Bedrock, SageMaker, and open models (Gemma) for autonomous data extraction.

• Mentorship & Governance: Delivered an enterprise cloud/AI curriculum, upskilling ~100 engineers and contractors on modern cloud architectures and agentic workflows.

• Recognition: Honored with the 2025 NESDIS Award for technical leadership, architectural innovation, and mission impact.
